change: Confirm pipeline terminal writes and stop automatic processing retry after uncertain completion

scenarios: one readback after lost acknowledgement without mutation or child replay
missing or conflicting persistence returns 503 without success audit
PostgreSQL JSON ordering and timestamp formatting
uncertain child completion is non-retryable and retained for review

limitations: Synthetic database/provider ports; no hosted processing or live-call acceptance
Child processing completion and per-recording concurrency still require review
Missing processing endpoints require coordinated TEST release with matching recovery handlers
Non-retryable applies to the current recovery job; a later scheduled/manual job is not fenced by a durable per-recording hold
